A coffeepot has the shape of a cylinder with radius 5 inches, as shown in the figure above. Let \(h\) be the depth of
the coffee in the pot, measured in inches, where \(h\) is a function of time \(t\), measured in seconds. The volume \(V\)
of coffee in the pot is changing at the rate of \(-5 \pi \sqrt{h}\) cubic inches per second. (The volume \(V\) of a cylinder with
radius \(r\) and height \(h\) is \(V=\pi r^{2} h\).)
(a) Show that \(\frac{d h}{d t}=-\frac{\sqrt{h}}{5}\).
(b) Given that \(h=17\) at time \(t=0\), solve the differential equation \(\frac{d h}{d t}=-\frac{\sqrt{h}}{5}\) for \(h\) as a function of \(t\).
(c) At what time \(t\) is the coffeepot empty?
